summary: Disk Analysis, free-space badges, and low-space alerts only consider real physical drives — not simulator images, DMGs, or other logical mounts.
changed: Volume discovery — Disk Analysis and notifications list only physical storage at / and /Volumes (internal SSD, USB, Thunderbolt)
Logical mounts ignored — simulator runtimes, disk images, cryptex, and network shares no longer appear as drives or trigger low-space alerts
